image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates surrounded by a dark, textured girdle. The surrounding environment includes small pebbles, algae, and possibly small snail shells.
